summary: Feed s104_single to IDS is degraded: 17.8% of frames (307/1728) truncated to ~256 bytes exceeds 5% threshold. IDS requires full payload for detection.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker has packet slicing enabled at ~256 bytes, likely to save bandwidth/tool capacity, cutting frames short before delivery to the IDS.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs full payload for signature matching and protocol analysis; truncated payload hides application content causing missed detections and reduced coverage.

recommended_fix.why: IDS requires full payload per tool profile; disabling slicing restores complete frames for accurate detection. If capacity is constrained, use filtering or load balancing instead of slicing.
